about: The design tokens outside the game, v3 (design v3, approved by David on 2026-10-04: one seed, an armoury at night; two materials, dark iron and the one parchment quest page; one accent, gold; the same numbers on both phones): one file, which tools/tokens.py turns into Swift for the Apple apps (apple/Shared/Tokens.swift), Kotlin for the Android apps (android/shared/.../Tokens.kt) and CSS custom properties for the desktop app and the site (helper/dist/style/tokens.css, site/src/styles/tokens.css: --qp-<group>-<name>). Colours are sRGB hex, or a colour at an opacity ({hex or color, opacity}); sizes are points (iOS) or dp and sp (Android); durations are milliseconds and curves cubic-bezier control points. `color` is the palette, `quality` the grades, `artTone` the art's own metal (contract/design/art), `family` the bundled faces, `type` the phones' type roles, `watchType` the watches' faces, `layout` the metrics, `desktop` the desktop app's own (the CSS alone), `surface` each kit component's look and `contrast` every foreground and background pair the apps draw, with its minimum (4.5 for text, 3 for control edges and graphics; `tools/tokens.py --check` fails on a pair below it). `feedback` is the event table of "Sound and haptics": every event names each column, null where it plays nothing, and every sound it names is in contract/design/sound/sounds.json.

color.about: The palette (design v3 §2). page, card and raised are the three tones of dark iron; line and lineStrong the warm hairlines cut from #F0D6A0 (decoration, never a control's only edge); text, text2 and text3 the three steps of words (text3 lifted from the mockup's #6F665A to 4.5:1 on page and card, since a 12-pt caps label is no WCAG large text; on raised it is 4.1:1, so words there take text2); gold with goldHi and goldLo its gradient's ends and goldInk the words on it, only on the primary button, a progress fill, the selected tab and the one key number; stop the unwell stop and errors; ok the connected dot; parchment and parchmentLo the quest page's gradient with ink and ink2 on it; track a bar's empty well; void the deepest dark (the dim under a window, the art's dark layers); black for shadows; figureCrimson the move figure's default tint, Figure.lua's CRIMSON {0.7674, 0.3132, 0.3132} to the byte; focusRing the keyboard's focus ring on the desktop app and the site (slice 35), never gold, which marks the one primary and the chosen tab: a mid blue, 3:1 and more on page, card, raised and both parchment tones (its luminance between the five's limits, 0.143 and 0.182). frost the rest mark's ice blue (2026-10-09): a day a rest token kept in the streak's week, a freeze and never a miss, on a graphic alone, never words or a control's edge

increaseContrast.about: The edges Increase Contrast (iOS colorSchemeContrast .increased, Android's raised contrast level) swaps in: a card's line edge becomes lineStrong and a control's lineStrong edge text3, 3:1 and more on every dark tone, and a progress track's track text3 (a talent tree's ring track; its rails on lineStrong and its quality dividers' line take the swaps above: 2026-10-16, slice 40's double-check).

quality.about: The seven qualities, Starter to Artifact (contract/sheet.json `qualities` 1 to 7, two steps each by contract/library.json's quality_by_step: EngineLibrary rungQuality; Artifact, the elite tier above orange, since 2026-10-05, in pale ice: a pale gold read as the gold accent and a champagne as Common's cream, questfit-12's mock of 2026-10-05; the game keeps WoW's own Artifact gold): our own tones, never WoW's. `tone` is the colour on dark iron (the gem, the word, a tile's 1.5-pt edge and its faint glow, the reached pips), 4.5:1 and more on page, card, raised and the tooltip; `ink` its twin for words on the parchment page (the share card), 4.5:1 on both parchment tones. Never a large fill, and never alone: the word goes with it.

artTone.about: The art's own metal (the helm, the portrait ring and the banner bar in contract/design/art), named by data-token beside `color`'s: never a surface, an edge or a text colour of the apps. steel and steelLo the blue steel of the app icon's plates (contract/design/icon/mark.svg, the quest scroll barbell, 2026-10-10), with frost as their light. wax the Quest Bill's seal's crimson wax (contract/design/art/seal.svg, the Saga, 2026-10-15), deeper than the mark's figureCrimson seal so the gold chevron stands out on the parchment.

family.about: The bundled faces (OFL; contract/design/ledger.json): each family's PostScript name per weight for a static family, or the family name and its weight steps for a variable one (one Font entry each on Android, so Bold Text's adjustment finds the next), and the generic family a web page falls back to while the face loads (`generic`, the CSS's). Every file's hhea and OS/2 typo metrics agree and its line gap is 0, so a line has the same height on both platforms (tools/tokens.py reads them from android/shared/src/main/res/font).

boldText.about: Bold Text (iOS legibilityWeight .bold, Android's Bold text): Android adds `adds` to every weight a text asks for (Configuration.fontWeightAdjustment, API 31 on) and Compose takes the family's face for it, so tools/tokens.py gives every Swift font the same face: Barlow 400 and 500 become Bold, 600 asks 900 and falls back to Bold, Barlow Condensed 700 stays Bold, Cinzel 700 becomes 900. A role whose family has no face from 600 for its bold weight, which Compose would fake bold, fails the check.

type.about: The phones' type roles (design v3 §2): a family and weight, a size (following Dynamic Type through `relativeTo`, Android's font scale through sp), the line pitch of a wrapped paragraph, tracking in em (0 but for caps, tab and the titles), capitals where `uppercase`, tabular figures where `tabular` and the role's colour (the caller passes another on parchment or gold). A line takes the role's `line` where it is more than the face's own line (Barlow 1.2 em, Cinzel 1.348 em, Barlow Condensed 1.2 em): iOS adds the difference as .lineSpacing, Android sets lineHeight with LineHeightStyle(Proportional, Trim.Both), the same height on both; a role whose `line` is under its face's own (the Cinzel titles, the numbers, tab) keeps the face's line on both, since iOS cannot set a negative spacing (design v3's parity research, "Type metrics").

watchType.about: The watches' type (design v3 on the wrist, 2026-10-04): the phones' families at the wrist's sizes. Words in Barlow as TextRoles, as the phones' roles are (a line, a colour, tracking and capitals; Dynamic Type and Wear OS's font scale grow them); one Cinzel word at most (the app's name, Ready, Resting); every number in Barlow Condensed at a fixed size (`fixed`: Swift's fixedSize, and on Wear OS its size in dp through Theme.kt `fixed`), so the running clock and the countdown digit keep their room at every text size, the digit drawn at a share of its ring (`surface.Watch.digitFraction`).

layout.about: The metrics (design v3 §2), pt on iOS and dp on Android: the page margin, the radii, the controls' heights and a button's gap between its glyph and its words, the bars, the rows, the glyphs and the tiles by their place, the spacing scale and the progress bars. The talent trees' metrics (slice 36; docs/ui.md, "The talent trees"): a tree's pitch, one ladder's column and one step's row, from treePitchMin 44 to treePitchMax 48, one pair for both phones (pt on the iPhone, dp on Android: clamp((width - branch gaps) / columns, 44, 48), so Flexibility's eight ladders and Strength's eight, each tree with its two branch gaps, fit edge to edge at 360 dp and 375 pt, and under 44 the board scrolls sideways); the node's MoveTile the pitch less treeTileInset 12, so a tree tile is 32 to 36: on each side, outward from the tile's quality edge, the ring's dark gap (ringGap 2, gold against Uncommon being 1.06:1), the ring (ringWidth 2, a gold progress stroke round the tile's rounded square) and 2 of clearance (6 a side, 12 in all), so two rings on one row stand 4 apart and never touch, and nothing a node draws crosses into its neighbour's pitch; the clearance holds one mark at a time, in this order: under a keyboard's focus the focus ring (wide.focusRingWidth at offset 0 from the ring's outer edge, in place of wide.focusRingOffset), the selected step's outline and Find a move's outline (each treeHalo wide in text, never by colour alone: the search adds its small mark), else the glow's halo (treeHalo 2, a soft gold glow round the ring, never past the clearance), each showing again once the mark above it goes; treeDivider 16, the height of the thin divider where a row's quality changes, which adds to the board's height: the caps role's line (16), so one QualityWord in caps stands on its hairline at the default text size without reaching a node's clearance, growing with the text as the word does; treeBranchGap 4 added between two branches, which carry no label; treeThinRow 12, the height of a row shrunk to a dot a ladder (a 6 dot with 3 above and below, on the spacing scale: about a quarter of a full row, so a new player's tree stays short); treeLink 2, the stroke of a selected step's link arrows, as heavy as the ring so neither outweighs the other and twice the hairline so it reads over the board; the beads and the mastered seal (slice 42; docs/ui.md, "The talent trees", "The beads" and "Mastered"): treeBeadRow 8, the height a row gains under its tiles where it holds a ringed step whose climb has a path, the band its beads stand in on the column's line, clear of the ring's gap and the clearance's one mark; treeBead 4, a bead's width, treeBeadGap 3 between two beads, in the path's order from the leading edge, centred on the column's line (three beads, the most a path holds, take 18, inside the narrowest pitch); treeMastered 10, the width of a mastered step's seal inside its tile at the bottom-trailing corner, at every tile size (surface.MoveTile), never in the clearance. The phones' wide layouts go by the Book's own width, never the device or the screen (slice 40): under treeCentredFrom 600 one tree under its Segmented, edge to edge out of the page's margins and scrolling sideways under 44 a column; from treeCentredFrom one tree centred; from treeThreeFrom 1100 the three trees side by side with no Segmented, each its own board; the wide layouts' pitch is taken inside the page's two margins (22 columns at 44 with the five branch gaps of treeBranchGap and two gaps of space24 between the trees take 1036, with the margins 1076, at 48 1164, so 1100 gives a pitch near 45). The QR well's most side, qrWell (slice 60, the desktop's until then): a code's QR on the phones' Link a device page and in the desktop app's pairing and link codes, which a phone's camera reads at arm's length; narrower only with the page or the column.

wide.about: The wide windows' metrics (slice 46; docs/ui.md, "Tablets and wide windows"), pt on iOS, dp on Android and CSS px on the desktop app, which all three read by the window's own width, never the device, the idiom or the screen (the desktop's from slice 35 until slice 46, then the phones' too): under column nothing changes from the phones' own layout; from column every root and pushed page is one centred column of at most column, extra width page ground, and the kit's Window is at most column wide on every window; the Book alone widens, to bookMost, its Moves grid as many tiles a row as fit at moveCellLeast with layout.space12 between them, three at the least and six at the most, and its talent trees by layout's treeCentredFrom and treeThreeFrom on the iPhone (Android and the computer show the ladders and their paths since 2026-10-29); from railFrom the ActionBar becomes the rail, rail wide (Material's navigation rail), down the window's leading edge under the window's own controls and over the Menu (a media query reads no custom property, so the page's own CSS states railFrom's width beside its token's name); a step's card pinned beside its step, stepCard wide, where the board has room for it beside the step and the text is below the accessibility sizes, else the kit's Window from the foot; from column a FigureStage's square at most figureMost (about the widest a phone draws a figure: a 430-pt phone's welcome figure, edge to edge inside its margins, is 390), so no figure fills a tablet's column; Big view (the countdown, a running move and the timed ask, read from the floor 1-3 m away) on a window at least bigViewFrom wide and bigViewFrom high: the pump's stage (surface.PumpStage), whose figure takes the height: on a window wider than bigViewStackWidthFraction of its height (a square window too, where the column beside draws a standing move larger than a stack would; bigViewStackFraction until 2026-10-23, stacking from a height of 0.8 of the width) the figure the whole height between the head and the foot and bigViewFigureWidthFraction of the width, and beside it one column, together in its middle, of the move's name (bigViewSideNameFraction of the window's height and at most bigViewSideNameWidthFraction of its width), the dial (as large as the column's width and the height the name and the words leave it) and the words (the running view's pace and its line); else the move's name on top (bigViewNameFraction of the height and at most bigViewNameWidthFraction of the width), the figure under it at most bigViewStackedFigureWidthFraction of the width and the height the others leave, and under the figure the dial (bigViewStackedDialFraction of the height and at most bigViewStackedDialWidthFraction of the width) with the words beside it; the words in either bigViewLineFraction of the window's shorter side, so the stop line keeps its size; in either the figure gives up its height first, down to surface.PumpStage.figureLeast (2026-10-23, David: "why sprawl so much smaller than push up": most moves' boxes stand about as high as they are wide, so the stage of 0.5 of the height between the name and the line, its dial beside it 0.8 of its height, held them by that height, until then; the clock, the digit or the goal bigViewHeroFraction, 0.38, of the window's height, with a set of reps' figure in its ring, before that), light on the night ground, the head and the foot at their own size (docs/ui.md, "Big view"); the hover wash a control lays over its fill under a pointer (Android's and the desktop app's; the iPad's is the system's hover effect), and the keyboard's focus ring's width and its gap outside the control's edge (its colour is color.focusRing; on a talent tree's node at offset 0, inside the pitch's clearance, layout's about; the iPad's is the system's focus effect).

desktop.about: The desktop app's own metrics (slice 35; docs/ui.md, "The desktop app"), CSS px, which tools/tokens.py writes into the CSS alone (the phones and the watches draw none of them; the column, the rail, the pinned step card, the hover wash and the focus ring went to `wide` in slice 46, which the phones read too): the main window's least size (or the screen's work area, if smaller; in logical px, as desk/place.rs holds it, so 384 CSS px wide at the page's default 125 %), and the least width of a StatStrip cell, under which the strip wraps its cells (the phones shrink a cell's name to fit instead, StatStrip.nameLeast) (the talent trees' treesFrom and pitch went on 2026-10-29, when the Book's ladders and paths replaced the trees on the computer). The Saga (2026-10-15): the hero's knight at most sagaFigureMost square (SagaHero.figureFraction of the hero's width below that); a pair of tiles side by side while each holds sagaTileLeast (the Muscles tile sagaMusclesTile wide beside the records, its figure sagaMuscleMap), stacked below; the hero's words under its number and the knight left out below sagaHeroStack of the hero's width, Earlier chapters' rows stacked below sagaChaptersStack of the list's and their rule left out below sagaChaptersRule, a bar's compact primary its glyph alone below barGlyphBelow of the bar's, and the Share window's preview beside its choices from shareBeside of its content's width, as tall as the window's height less shareChrome (its margins, head and foot) beside them or less shareStackedChrome (the choices too) over them, never under sharePreviewLeast wide (container queries, which read no custom property: the page's CSS states each beside its token's name). The pump on a short window (2026-11-03's QA; pump.css, whose queries read no custom property): Ready's figure keeps surface.PumpReady.figureLeast only while the words under it keep pumpWordsLeast (a name with its quality over its goal), and is left out in a body under pumpFigureFrom, the count's in a body under pumpCountFigureFrom, whose number stands over its question in a body under pumpCountNumberFirstUnder, and under pumpFootRowUnder of the window's height the foot runs in a row.

surface.about: Each kit component's look (design v3 §2 and §3, from the approved mockups' qp.css), one group named as its component. A value is a colour (a name of `color`, `quality.<q>`, #RRGGBB, or {hex or color, opacity}); a length (a bare number, pt or dp), or a share (a key ending in Opacity or Fraction) or a count (ending in Count, or a number in the unit its key ends in: Fps, Frames, Kbps, Hz or Db, as the day reel's encoding, `fps` alone naming its unit); a gradient ({stops: [[colour, at], ...]}, top to bottom unless its about says across, or radial with a `center` and `radii` as shares of the box, CSS's radial-gradient(<radii> at <center>)); a shadow or glow ({colour, opacity, radius, x, y}: radius is CSS's blur); or a band, a line of colour inside an edge ({colour, opacity, width}: an inner highlight under the top edge, a shade over the bottom, the primary's lip under it).

Page.about: The page: page, full bleed, under a warm light from above (radial, 120 % × 55 % at 50 % −10 %, gold at 10 % to clear by 70 %); the result and the first start light it from the middle (glowResult, glowWelcome).

Card.about: A card, the one container: card, a 1-pt line edge (Tokens.edge), an inner top highlight.

PrimaryButton.about: The primary button: goldHi to gold at 48 % to goldLo, an inner top highlight, an inner bottom shade, a 3-pt lip under it and a soft gold glow; pressed: no lip, 2 pt lower (press), darker; disabled: raised, text3 words, no glow; busy: three pips lit in turn, each fading to busyDimOpacity. Compact (the Saga's TopBar and DetailBar, 2026-10-15): compactHeight high, compactRadius corners, as wide as its glyph and words with compactPad either side, the same fill, highlight, shade and glow, no lip.
PrimaryButton.label: goldInk

SecondaryButton.about: The secondary button: raised, a lineStrong edge, an inner top highlight, text words.
SecondaryButton.label: text

Press.about: Any pressed control: darker by black at shadeOpacity, and 2 pt lower where it stands on a lip.

RoundButton.about: The round button (40, 36 in a pump): card, a line edge, a text2 glyph of 20; More's three dots moreDot round, 6 apart (space6).

QuestPage.about: The parchment quest page: the parchment gradient, an inner 1-pt edge, an inner vignette, a drop shadow, 20 of padding; its rules 1-pt lines of `rule` fading to clear at both ends.

ShareCard.about: The share card's two Pro styles (slice 34), each a quest page of its own on the same iron page, with the same figure, quality edges and layout as the free Parchment, which is the quest page as it is (QuestPage): Night the app's iron (`nightGround`, top to bottom) inside a gold edge (`nightEdge`, `nightEdgeWidth` in from its outline) with light words (`nightWords`, `nightWords2`), gold rules, no vignette and an unlock's line in its quality's tone; Gilded the parchment with its vignette and ink words inside a band of the gold that stands on parchment (`gildedEdge`, the reward pill's glyph gold: 3.1:1 on parchmentLo, 4.1:1 on the page), its rules in that gold and an unlock's line in its quality's ink twin. No texture, ornament or corner piece (design v3).

RewardPill.about: A reward on the website's quest page (QuestPage.astro; the apps' Ready view draws the kit's Chip since 2026-10-24): a 34-high pill of ink at 8 %, a 1-pt edge, its glyph of 20 in `glyph`.

MoveTile.about: A move tile: the key pose on a dark radial well, in a 1.5-pt edge of its quality's tone (Tokens.Layout.tileEdge) with a faint outer glow of it and a black inner line; untrained: the lineStrong edge, the pose at 75 %; switched off for pumps (Book): the pose at 40 % with a small Off mark centred on its top corner, half outside it; a favourite (Book, slice 30): a star of favouriteStar in text on a round raised mark of favouriteMark with a lineStrong edge, centred on its top-leading corner, half outside it, the Off mark's twin (never gold; a tile can carry both); ahead (slice 36, in place of locked: a step ahead in a tree or on a ladder's page, a move above the player's reach): the pose greyed (no colour) on the well, its edge in aheadEdge, text3, at 3:1 against the page, the card and the well since it is still a button; no still to show (a move whose figure the build lacks): the well and the pump glyph of `glyph` in text3 (the locked face went in slices 38 and 39, ahead in its place); empty (a step no rung stands on): the well alone; mastered (slice 42, a step whose every move the setup offers reached its top): a round seal of layout.treeMastered in `masteredSeal` with a check in `masteredCheck`, inside the tile's edge at its bottom-trailing corner at every size, the tree size's one mark; topped (slice 42, a step card's group tile whose move reached its top once): the favourite's mark at the bottom-trailing corner, a check of favouriteStar in text on a round raised mark of favouriteMark with a lineStrong edge, centred on the corner, half outside it.

QualityWord.about: A quality word's gem: a gem square turned 45°, its corners gemRadius round, gemGap from the word, growing with the words.

ActionBar.about: The action bar's four tabs (five on the desktop app since slice 56, with Games): a dark gradient strip with a lineStrong top edge and a gold shine fading out to both sides along it (`shine`, across), a 26-pt glyph over the tab label, the chosen one gold with a 26 × 3 gold marker and its glow above the glyph, the others text3.

Tooltip.about: A tooltip: a blue-black box with a cool edge and a shadow; its meta line in `meta`; width wide (its words wrap inside), on Hero's map beside a muscle and over a tile in the Book.

Toggle.about: A toggle, 50 × 30: off a dark track with a pale knob, on the gold gradient with a light knob.

Segmented.about: The segmented control: a card well, the chosen segment raised with a highlight and a shadow.
Segmented.label: text2

Chip.about: A chip: a 32-high pill (Tokens.Layout.chipHeight) of card with a line edge, its dot 8 with a glow of its colour (ok when the helper answers, amber and pulsing while the app reaches for it, text3 without one); the record chip 36 high in the uncommon tone, its edge and fill that tone at recordEdgeOpacity and recordFillOpacity.
Chip.label: text2

Stepper.about: The stepper: − and + keys, 64 round, raised with a lineStrong edge and a highlight, their signs sign high at every text size, 22 from the value.

TimerRing.about: The timer ring, the pump's dial: an 8-pt track in `track` and a gold arc (goldHi to goldLo) with a glow, round caps, from 12 o'clock, around a circular well inset 22, its face, holding what the moment shows: the countdown's digit, Go for a move's first second, the clock, the count or the goal, with its goal or its word under it (since 2026-10-23 the move's figure stands beside it on the PumpStage; the well held it until then, dimmed to countdownFigureOpacity under the countdown's digit, which the site's picture of the pump, TimerRing.astro, still draws). Its words are shares of its side on every surface (fixed, never the text size's; the voice and the screen reader carry them): the digit dialDigitFraction, Go dialGoFraction, the clock dialClockFraction, a count or a goal dialCountFraction, a word (Max set, One set) dialWordFraction, the line under them dialCaptionFraction. On a pump screen it gives up height before a button leaves the first view (the largest text), after the PumpStage has given up its own: its side shrinks with the room down to `least`, and under that it draws the clock alone, no arc (the move's tile, Tokens.Layout.tile, over the clock until 2026-10-23, while the well held the figure).

PumpStage.about: The pump's stage from the countdown through a running move (2026-10-23, David: "make the excercise way better and visible during the countdown"): the move's FigureStage filling its room, the figure's own box (contract/figures/figures.json `box`, as drawn: mirrored on a side move's other side) as large as the room holds it at figureFillFraction of the room's width and height, in the room's middle, the square scaled and moved about it and the room's edges fading out over edgeFadeFraction of each side where the square runs past them; the figure whole, never dimmed, playing its loop from the countdown on (a set of reps' phased to its go), on the room's page ground; and the TimerRing as its dial. On a phone's screen (no Big view) the move's name over the stage, the stage taking the room between the name and the dial, at least figureLeast high, and under it the dial at phoneDial with the words (the running view's pace and its line) beside it, so the figure, not the line, takes the height (2026-10-23, David: "why sprawl so much smaller than push up"; the dial 200 under the stage with the line under the dial until then); at the largest text the stage gives up its height first, down to figureLeast, then the dial as TimerRing says. Big view's shares are wide's bigView*.

PumpReady.about: A pump's Ready view, the move up next in full, as the game's Ready view shows it (2026-10-24, David: "It should be like the addon. Just go right away in and show whats up next."; a quest page of every move's small line until then): the move's FigureStage playing its loop, its figure's box as large as its room holds it at PumpStage's figureFillFraction with PumpStage's edge fade, and the move's words beside or under it. On a window narrower than besideFrom the figure on top, figureHeightFraction of the page's height between its head and its pinned foot and at least figureLeast high, the words under it and the page scrolling under the head; from besideFrom wide the figure beside the words, figureWidthFraction of the page's width and the page's whole height, the words' column scrolling on its own.

Watch.about: The watches' parts (design v3 on the wrist, 2026-10-04): buttons `button` high as capsules (Wear OS asks 40 at least, the Apple Watch 44; the primary gold with the phones' glow at `glowFraction` of its blur and offset, the secondary raised, the stop card with stop words), the session's Pump `pump` high, the running clock's size chosen by the width first (`Tokens.Watch.clock` where it fits beside the round Back and its mirror space, else `clockCompact`), then by the height at `clockCompact` where a pump's own screen has no room for `Tokens.Watch.clock` (its side and its target's bar given up first), the count's number at `clockCompact`, the countdown's ring with a `ringStroke` track round its digit (drawn at `digitFraction` of the ring), the move's figure `figure` high over it where the box holds the figure, its `gap` and a ring of at least `ringWithFigure` and half the width (the figure giving way first, then the coach's cue words), `gap` between a screen's parts, a one-line label (the stop's words, a number's name) shrinking to `shrinkFraction` of its size before it would break (never a caps label: one that will not fit takes a shorter key, never a size under the caps role's 11), a list row (`WatchRow`, slice 31) at least `row` high with a quality's gem (`QualityGem`) `gem` wide, the glance's front-and-back body figure (`GlanceFigure`, slice 32) `glanceFigure` high as its hero, and when a screen runs out of room the same parts giving way in the same order on both watches: the readings row first, then the side words and the target's bar, then the clock's size, never the stop, the primary or Back; and in Always On and ambient no fills: the gold and the edges drawn as `ambientEdge` lines on black, the readings at `dimOpacity` (a pressed quiet button's words too), a disabled button at `disabledOpacity`.

XPBar.about: The XP bar (8 high, 6 on Hero; Tokens.Layout): the track with an inset shadow, the fill goldHi to goldLo, the rested part past it in gold at 28 %.

StepsBar.about: The steps bar: one 4-high bar per move, 6 apart; done goldLo, now gold with a glow, the rest `track`. An unfinished move riding a match's pump (slice 61) is the Legendary orange (Rapha, 2026-11-02: "banked in orange"): not yet done `rider`, done `riderDone`, now `riderNow` with `riderGlow`, and the word Banked (kit.steps.banked) in the caps type in `riderNow` centred above the riders, `labelGap` over their bars.

StepPips.about: A ladder's 14 pips, two a quality from Starter to Artifact (12 until 2026-10-05, when gold came above orange; Tokens.Layout pipWidth, pipHeight, pipGap): the reached in the quality's tone.

RungStars.about: A rung's three stars (slice 30: the ladder's page's now step): stars of `star`, `gap` apart, an earned one in gold (a progress fill), the others in text3, 3:1 and more on card (contrast.graphics), so a sighted player counts all three; the count also in words for VoiceOver and TalkBack (kit.stars.label).

DayPips.about: An unlock's days (slice 30: the ladder's page's next step): round pips of `pip`, `gap` apart, a day that counted lit in gold (progress), the rest in text3, 3:1 and more on card (contrast.graphics), so a sighted player sees the days still to go; the count also in words for VoiceOver and TalkBack (kit.days.label).

Chart.about: The Pro charts' one block on both phones (slice 30): the axis in caps in axis, the grid in grid at gridWidth, the one line or the bars in mark, dots at dot, a record day's star at star, the stair's treads at tread in their quality's tone with risers at riser in riserColour, a loss in loss, the height from height up to heightMax, the stair rungRow a rung, the time axis labelled every labelDayCount days or labelWeekCount weeks, a week's bar barWidth wide, a legend's swatch swatch square, a muscle's week weekCell square at most; Pro's weeks (slice 34) stack a week's moves done by where they were done (its pumps until 2026-10-27) in game (in the game), catchUp (the catch-ups) and app (the phone's, the watch's, the computer's and the linked games'), stackGap apart, each colour's word in the legend.

FigureStage.about: The figure stage: the gold plinth glow under the figure, an ellipse plinthWidthFraction of the stage wide and plinthHeight high, its middle on the figure's feet (plinthBottomFraction from the bottom under a move's glyph); the edges of the figure's square that cut its floor light fade out over fadeFraction of its side.

WeekDots.about: The week's seven marks, 30 round, in two states. Days (Pump home, the Streak widget): a raised mark with a line edge (lineStrong under Increase Contrast), a pump day lit goldHi to goldLo with a glow and a goldInk check of 12, a rested day (one a rest token kept, 2026-10-09) the raised mark with its edge and the rest mark (a snowflake) of restSize in rest, a resting day (felt unwell, which the streak skips) the raised mark with its edge and the pause mark of restSize in resting, never red and never crossed out, today ringed in gold. Steps (Pro's weeks, slice 34; a muscle's weeks and the step legend take the same look on their squares): a day by its moves in the body map's capped steps, never relative to the busiest day: none the raised mark with its line edge, 1-3 moves stepLow (gold at half over card: goldLo beside gold is only 1.5:1), 4-9 the on radial, 10 and more the on radial with stepCap, a goldInk ring dashed stepCapDash on and off, stepCapInset inside the edge (never a brighter fill); a record day the star at checkSize in check where the check stands, no glow and no check; a day still to come the raised mark with no edge; today ringed in gold.

StatStrip.about: The stat strip's names shrink to fit their cell, to nameLeast at the smallest. Its qualities state (slice 30: the Book's colour card) lays its cells in rows of at most rowCellCount, each a quality's gem at QualityWord's gem size, its count and its word in its tone.

Fanfare.about: The fanfare's title (type fanfare) and the first start's wordmark: goldHi with a soft gold glow; the gold bar under the title bar wide.

LevelBadge.about: The level badge on Hero: gold, radius 6, the level in goldInk Barlow 700 13.
LevelBadge.label: goldInk

BodyMap.about: Hero's body map (design v3 §4): the dark figure, each trained muscle in its quality's tone at fillOpacity over it, an untrained muscle in untrained; the muscle a tap chose at full tone with the selected edge. On a move's page (slice 30) the move's primary muscles take fillOpacity and its secondary ones secondaryFraction of it. A move's page draws it cardHeight high in its Trains card (slice 30). The Saga's day (2026-10-15; contract/fixtures/history.json saga rule 11) fills a muscle a move of the day names as primary (mp) in dayMost and one it names only as secondary (ms) in dayMost at daySomeOpacity, the rest untrained, front and back as Hero draws them, with the Most and Some legend.

KindTile.about: A log row's kind: a 40 raised square, radius 10, a line edge, a text2 glyph of 22.

Portrait.about: The helm portrait in its ring (TalkingHead, Hero, the Pro card): 64, the helm inset 13.

ProCard.about: The Menu's Pro card: a card under a gold wash from its top leading corner to its bottom trailing one (`wash`, along that diagonal), in a gold edge at 28 %.

Window.about: A window: a card over the dim (void at 60 %), centred or from the bottom, at most wide.column wide. On the phones (slice 46; docs/ui.md, "Tablets and wide windows", "Drag to close") a window with a close closes with a downward drag from its head, or from its words while they stand at their top: it follows the finger and its dim fades with its travel, to clear at its own height; a release past dragClose of travel or above dragFlick a second downward closes it, else it settles back (both in motion.windowDrag; Material's sheet values, androidx.compose.material3 SheetDefaults' PositionalThreshold 56 dp and VelocityThreshold 125 dp, read 2026-10-18). A drag the window resists (upward on every window, and any way on one without a close or with unsaved choices, which only rubber-bands) moves it (x × d × c) / (d + c × x) for the finger's travel x, d the window's height and c dragResistFraction (the constant commonly measured in UIScrollView's bounce), so it never passes its own height and comes back with windowDrag.

MoveWindow.about: A move's window: its figure's stage figure high.

Toast.about: The toast: its widest, and how many wait behind the one showing (a newer one drops the oldest waiting).

EmptyState.about: An empty state's glyph, glyph square.

RewardRow.about: The result's reward rows: the first soundedRevealCount each play their event as they show (a record's `record`, an unlock's colour, a title's `title`, else `reveal`; one jingle a Result, a row whose jingle has played takes `reveal`), the rest show silently, so a long list never rattles; as a row shows, its tile's edge shines once (chipShine: an edge stroke in `shine` swelling and fading, never on a Rekindled row), and an Epic, Legendary or Artifact tile's quality glow then rises once to pulseOpacity and back (pulse).

Kinds.about: The day's four kinds (the Saga, 2026-10-15; contract/fixtures/history.json saga rule 10): a move's block in contract/library.json, strength, cardio, mobility and yoga, each a tone on dark iron (the day's strip, the kinds bar, the cards' Night style) and an ink twin on parchment (the Parchment and Gilded cards), 3:1 and more on the grounds they stand on (contrast.graphics), and always with its word beside it or in the legend, never the colour alone: strength the gold, cardio the knight's crimson, mobility frost, yoga the parchment's tone. The kinds bar (KindBar): one bar barHeight high of the day's moves split by kind, strength, cardio, mobility, yoga from the leading edge, its ends round, the parts barGap apart, each kind's word (type label, text2) with its count (numRow) under its part; a tick tickWidth wide and tickHeight high in `tick`, ringed by tickRing of the tile's card, at each boundary of the player's focus shares (contract/library.json constants.focus_share), its legend a tick and {Focus} plan.

DayStrip.about: The day's strip (the Saga, 2026-10-15; contract/fixtures/history.json saga rule 9): the 24 hours of the game day from its 04:00 to the next on one axis, each pump a bar barWidth wide at its start's place, its moves stacked from the axis up as blocks in the kinds' order (strength, cardio, mobility, yoga; Kinds' tones, their inks on parchment), a block blockHeight high and blockGap apart (a run of one kind one block of their height), blockRadius round; the bars in minute order (then pump order) at one pitch for the day: the largest that lets every bar stand at or right of its own start and inside the axis (the least, over each bar k, of the room from its start to the axis's end over the bars from k on), never more than barWidth plus barGap; below that the gap closes first (to 0) and then the bars narrow alike (never under 1 px), so a crowded hour reads as a solid block at its hour; each bar at its start or a pitch right of the one before, whichever is later, and only bars that still pass the axis's end at 1 px and no gap shift back left from the end; the stack holds rowCount blocks, every block shrinking alike when the day's tallest pump holds more; the axis a hairline in `axis`, faint dashed rules in `grid` (gridDash on, gridGap off) at each block row; each time bucket with moves its total in Barlow Condensed 700 at totalSize in `total` centred over its bars (moved apart from its neighbour's as the bucket words are) and its word in Barlow 600 caps at labelSize tracked labelTrackingFraction em in text2 under the axis, 04:00 in Barlow 500 at endSize in text3 at both ends (a graphic's fixed sizes, never Dynamic Type). On parchment (the cards' Parchment and Gilded) the axis in axisInk, the rules in gridInk, the totals in totalInk (large text, 3:1), the words and ends in ink2 and the blocks in the kinds' inks. Before the day's first move the axis and its ends alone. The Quest Bill draws the same bars as barcode bars (QuestBill).

SlantTag.about: The slanted tag (the Saga, 2026-10-15): a box slanted by slantFraction of its height (its top leaning right, CSS's skewX(-14deg)), its words upright in caps (type caps, weight 700) with an optional star (Art.star) of starSize before them; outlined, an edge of edgeWidth with the words in its colour (a chapter's tag gold, an earlier chapter's text3, a quality word's in the quality's tone, its ink twin on parchment), or filled (Best day ever: gold with goldInk words and the star; the streak card's Milestone on a milestone count, slice 45: gold with goldInk words and no star, the star staying Best day ever's); a sticker's tag is outlined, never filled, in its gold (Milestone too); padH by padV inside, radius corners.

WeekStrip.about: The week's seven bars (the Saga's Week tile and the week card, 2026-10-15; contract/fixtures/history.json saga rule 17): one bar a day of the game week, barWidth wide, height high at the week's most moves (or at the old best where that is more), barLeast at the least for a day with a move, radius corners, in `bar` (WeekDots' stepLow, 3:1 on card); the day the page shows in gold, ringed by ringGap of the tile's card and a ring of ringWidth in goldHi; a day without a move no bar (a rested day, one a rest token kept, a restHeight bar in WeekDots' rest at restOpacity); the old best a dashed line (dash on and off) in oldBest across the bars at its height, its legend a dash with Old best and the number; each day's letter under its bar in caps text3, the shown day's in goldHi. On parchment (the week card's Parchment and Gilded): the bars stay `bar` (4:1 there), the shown day in todayInk ringed in ringInk, the old best in oldBestInk and the letters in ink2.

SagaHero.about: The Saga's hero (the Saga tab's today, a day's page and Pump home's Today's chapter, 2026-10-15): the day's moves in type numSaga filled with `number` (top to bottom), shrinking to fit 3 or 4 digits down to numberLeastFraction of its size, Moves beside it in Barlow Condensed 700 caps at movesFraction of the number's size (42 at 192) and the quality's SlantTag under that; the hero move's key-pose still figureFraction of the page's width square over the number's right on the dark page, no well, cut out by a radial mask opaque to maskFraction of its half-width and clear at its edge, figureShadow under it; the ground under the hero lit by a gold glow behind the figure (`glow`), a faint crimson one top left (`warm`) and the diagonal stripes (`stripe` every stripePitch, rising 28° from the vertical, CSS's 118deg), over the top groundHeight of the page, `glow` and `warm` placed as shares of that box, all faded out from groundFadeFraction of its height down; the highlight under the number: a ruleWidth by ruleHeight gold rule and its caps line (Unlocked today in gold, Record today) over the move's name and its quality word or its record.

SagaCard.about: The Saga card and the week card (the Share window's Saga, 2026-10-15), drawn at scaleCount pixels a point, `width` wide (1080 px), in four formats: square squareHeight high, post postHeight (4:5), story storyHeight (9:16; every word inside storySafeTop from its top and storySafeBottom from its bottom, where the apps' own chrome lies) and the sticker (Saga only, as high as its blocks, on a clear ground); margin from each side. Its blocks: the app mark (Art.appMark, markSize) and My saga in Cinzel 700 at titleSize tracked 0.16 em in goldHi with the chapter line in caps text2; the number at numberStory, numberPost or numberSquare in SagaHero's `number`, grouped by the locale (1,050) and shrinking beside its words to fit 3 or 4 digits down to numberLeastFraction of its size, never cut, with Moves today (an earlier day's card: Moves) in Barlow Condensed 700 caps at movesStory, movesPost or movesSquare and the quality's SlantTag; the hero knight figureStory, figurePost or figureSquare square, cut out as on the page; the highlight line; the strip (DayStrip; the week card its seven WeekStrip); three stats (records, XP, day streak; the week card days, records, XP) each its number at statSize over its caps word, lineStrong hairlines between them, a stat at 0 or unknown left out; questpump.com small at the foot after the mark at siteMark. Night: My saga alone in goldHi, every other gold accent (the highlight's rule, its caps line and a record's value, the stats' glyphs) in gold; `nightGround` (top to bottom) under `glow` behind the knight and `warm` top left (the post's glowPost and warmPost, the square's the post's) and SagaHero's stripes, nightEdgeLine gold lines fading out to both ends along the top and bottom edges; Parchment: the quest page's ground (QuestPage) with ink words, the number in parchmentNumber (the gold that stands on parchment, as large text 3:1), the strip in the kinds' inks, the knight in a dark well (MoveTile's well, wellRadius round) since the stills wash out on light ground; Gilded: Parchment inside ShareCard's gilded band. The sticker: text words, each with stickerShadow under it and a stickerStroke outline in stickerStrokeColour, so they read on any picture. The day reel (slice 45, SagaReel) draws the Story layout with every word reelSafeTop from its top, reelSafeBottom from its bottom and reelSafeRight from its right edge, the room a Story's, a Reel's and a TikTok's own buttons and captions take; the grounds, the knight and the strip's bars may run under them.

QuestBill.about: The Quest Bill (the Share window's second card, 2026-10-15): a receipt on its own iron ground (`ground`, radial from the top middle) in SagaCard's formats and styles, paperMargin from the card's sides, turned turnFraction of a turn anticlockwise (1.2°), `shadow` under it, its top and bottom edges torn in teeth toothWidth wide (peak to peak) and toothDepth deep; the paper `paper` (top to bottom) under a light at its top left (`paperLight`) and a shade at its bottom right (`paperShade`), padding inside, words in ink and ink2 (Parchment: the light paper; Night: nightPaper with nightInk, nightInk2 and nightRecord and a nightEdge line along its torn outline; Gilded: the light paper with the card inside ShareCard's gilded band). Every word in Barlow Condensed 700 takes its tabular figures (the numLarge role's), so the digits of a column line up (board B-Feed's counts, amounts and total). The Quest Bill in Cinzel 800 at titleSize tracked 0.07 em over its date line in Barlow Condensed 700 caps at dateSize tracked dateTrackingFraction em in ink2; a dashed `rule` (ruleDash on and off); a line a move: the moves with a record or an unlock that day first, then the others, each group the most done first (then the one done first, then the lower move id), every word in Barlow Condensed 700 caps at lineSize: its count in ink2 at the end of a column as wide as the widest count of the lines shown, countGap before the name, so every name starts at one place (board B-Feed's receipt column), its name tracked nameTrackingFraction em on one line (a long one cut with …), a record's New {value} in `record` after a small seal (Art.seal at recordSeal, drawn as is: its wax `wax` and gold chevron, never tinted; Layout.space4 before New) or an unlock's Unlocked · {quality} in its quality's ink, a dotted `leader` (leaderDot on and off) and the move's reps or seconds; at most lineCount lines, then the more line in Barlow Condensed 700 caps at moreSize tracked moreTrackingFraction em in ink2: + at the start of the counts' column, N more lines where the names start, a dotted leader and their moves; the total's double rule (totalRuleTop over totalRuleBottom, totalRuleGap apart, in ink); Total · Paid in full in Cinzel 800 at totalSize, the day's moves in Barlow Condensed 700 at numberSize in ink (shrinking beside Moves and the seal to fit 3 or 4 digits down to SagaCard's numberLeastFraction, never cut) with Moves in Cinzel 800 at movesWordSize, +N XP (the day's XP alone, the line gone when none is known; in N pumps · +XP until 2026-10-27) in Barlow 600 at xpSize in ink2; the wax seal (Art.seal at sealSize, its wax `wax`, turned a 30th of a turn anticlockwise) with My best day or the day's quality word under it in `record`, Cinzel 800 at sealWordSize, no seal before the gate; the strip as barcode bars (one a pump at its start's place, barcodeBase + barcodePerMove × its moves wide, barcodeHeight high, in ink; an hour tick tickWidth wide and tickHeight high in ink2 at tickOpacity each hour, a full-height one every six) between the day's turns (04:00 and 04:00 in Barlow Condensed 700 at footSize in ink2, Layout.space6 from the bars); Layout.space8 under it the foot, a line as high as the mark with its words centred in it on one baseline, all at footSize in ink2: My game day, a bar a pump in Barlow Condensed 700 caps tracked footTrackingFraction em (where the line has no room, smaller down to footLeastFraction of its size, then cut with …) and at the line's end the mark (Art.appMark at siteMark, drawn as is) Layout.space6 before questpump.com in Barlow 600 (boards B-Feed and B-Story).

SagaReel.about: The day reel (slice 45; contract/fixtures/history.json saga rule 18 picks its moves, motion.sagaReel times it): the day's Saga card in SagaCard's Story layout with the reel's insets, SagaCard.width by storyHeight at scaleCount (1080 × 1920 pixels, coded upright: no rotation flag in the file), at most moveCount moves. One encoding on every surface: H.264 High profile at level 4.0, progressive, fps frames a second at a constant rate, BT.709 primaries, transfer and matrix in the video range (16-235), signalled in the stream; a closed GOP, an IDR key frame every keyEveryFrames frames and no B-frames; a variable bit rate averaging bitrateKbps, which keeps a reel of 9.5 s at about 6 MB, under 8 MB on every encoder. Its sound, with Sound on: AAC-LC at audioHz in stereo at audioKbps, the app's own sounds (contract/design/sound/sounds.json, never licensed music) each mixed at gainDb; a sound whose file the app lacks, that does not decode or that holds no sound is logged and its cue left silent, and the reel is made without it, on every surface (one rule on the three apps since the program's double-check, 2026-10-19); with Sound off no audio track at all. An MP4 whose moov box comes before its mdat, with no metadata items (no title, date, place, device or encoder tag) and no time of its making (the creation and modification times of the mvhd and of every tkhd and mdhd 0, zeroed after a writer that stamps its own has finished); an ASCII file name; once made, the reel the only file in its folder (no writer's temporary file left beside it). A shot's words in the card's highlight slot are its move's QuestBill line in the bill's words (Barlow Condensed 700 caps with its tabular figures at lineSize, its count QuestBill.countGap before the name, the name tracked QuestBill.nameTrackingFraction, the small seal, Art.seal drawn as is, recordSeal wide and Layout.space4 before New, on Night the words' gold `gold`), its name on one line: whole, else cut with … after its last whole word that fits, a first word too wide alone cut inside it, so the slot keeps one height for every shot of every day.

StreakCard.about: The streak card (slice 45; the Share window's card for a streak milestone and for the StreakBoard's Share): SagaCard's formats (Story, Post, Square and the Sticker), styles, grounds, margins, mark, number, words, figure slot and site line, its blocks in the Saga card's places: the app mark and A quest a day. in Cinzel 700 at SagaCard.titleSize in goldHi (parchmentNumber on Parchment and Gilded) over the date in caps text2 (ink2 on parchment); the streak's count at SagaCard's numberStory, numberPost or numberSquare in SagaHero's number, grouped by the locale and shrinking only to fit, with Day streak in Barlow Condensed 700 caps at SagaCard's movesStory, movesPost or movesSquare (Year streak, the count then in years, for a whole number of years from 730 days) and, on a count contract/library.json's constants.streak_milestones holds, the SlantTag in its milestone state (Milestone); the standard-bearer (the figure extra streak_banner, contract/figures/figures.json) in the class colour in the knight's slot and look, SagaCard's figureStory, figurePost or figureSquare (cut out on Night, in the dark well on Parchment and Gilded); the day grid in the strip's place, gridStory, gridPost or gridSquare high and the card's width less its two margins (312) wide: a cell a day of the streak, oldest first from the top left, rows filled left to right and the last row's cells at its left, laid out by contract/fixtures/history.json saga rule 19 (the column count whose cell is largest, never over cellMost, the gap gapFraction of a cell, then the fewest rows, then the fewest columns), each cell a square with cellRadiusFraction of its side rounded in `cell` (cellInk on Parchment and Gilded), from checkFrom up with Art.markCheck checkFraction of the cell in its middle in `check`; the character's name in caps text2 (ink2 on parchment) where the Saga card's stats stand, left out without one; questpump.com at the foot after the mark. The Sticker: the count, Day streak or Year streak, the Milestone tag outlined and A quest a day., in light words with SagaCard's stickerStroke and stickerShadow, no figure, no grid and no name. Never on it: a heart rate or any Health or Motion value, game art, a quest, zone, realm, class or race word, Pro or a price.

ExpeditionBar.about: The expedition's bar (slice 51; ExpeditionBar): segments height high with round ends (radius), segmentGap apart across the bar's width: a round's segment the width the rest leave, the warm-up's and the cool-down's shortFraction of a round's; done goldLo, the one in play gold with StepsBar's glow, the rest `track`; the stage's caps (type label, text2) at the leading edge and the clock mark (mark_clock, clockSize, text2) with the minutes left (numRow, text) at the trailing edge, lineGap over the segments.

ExpeditionRest.about: The breather between two rounds (slice 51; expedition.round, desk.expedition.round): the TimerRing at ringSize (TimerRing's own track, arc, glow and well, no figure in the well, the seconds in numHero), giving up height as every pump screen's ring does down to TimerRing.least; the next round's MoveTiles at Tokens.Layout tile size 52, tileGap apart, each with its name (type meta, text2) under it, at most four in a row.

ExpeditionCard.about: The expedition card (slice 51; the Share window's card as an expedition's Result ends): SagaCard's formats (Story, Post and Square; no Sticker), styles, grounds, margins, mark, number, words, figure slot, three stats and site line, its blocks in the Saga card's places: the app mark and Expedition in Cinzel 700 at SagaCard.titleSize over the date in caps; the minutes at SagaCard's numberStory, numberPost or numberSquare with minutes in caps and the place's words (type label) under them; the lead move's figure at its key pose in the knight's slot; the MuscleMap's day variant in the strip's place, mapStory, mapPost or mapSquare high and the card's width less its margins wide (BodyMap's day colours; on Parchment and Gilded the map's untrained fill `mapParchment`); Moves, Records and XP as SagaCard's three stats (a stat at 0 left out); the character's name and questpump.com as the Saga card's.

StreakPage.about: The streak page (slice 51; pump.streak, desk.streak): the standard-bearer (the figure extra streak_banner) figureHeight high beside the hero number; the month's WeekDots (their own size and marks) with monthGap between rows; the rest tokens' slots, token_max in a row slotGap apart, each a slotSize round: a held token `slotFill` with the rest mark (mark_rest) of slotGlyph in `slotHeld`, an empty slot no fill and its `slotEdge` alone; the next milestone's bar StepsBar's look, one bar of barHeight, done goldLo to the days reached and the track after.

BestDay.about: The best-day moment (the Saga, 2026-10-15; log.best, desk.log.best): the iron page under `ground` (radial, its middle at 40 % down) and the rays: rayCount rays from that point, each rayFraction of its sector lit in `ray`, fading out to raysRadius from it, turning one full turn in motion.bestDayRays (still under Reduce Motion), SagaHero's stripes at stripeOpacity over all; Ding! in Barlow Condensed 700 caps at dingSize in goldHi tracked dingTrackingFraction em; the banner bar (Art.bannerBar, barWidth wide) above and under New best day (type fanfare); the day's moves at numberSize in `number` (top to bottom) with numberGlow and numberShadow, shrinking to fit 3 or 4 digits as SagaHero's does; the knight (the jumping jacks' key-pose still, arms up) `figure` square behind the number's foot with figureShadow, its top figureTopFraction of the number's size below the number's top, so its helmet and raised arms show under the digits (board A-Best); Moves in one day in Barlow Condensed 700 caps at labelSize tracked labelTrackingFraction em in text; Your old best in type subtitle; the primary Share it and the quiet Close.

LadderTree.about: A talent tree's board (slice 36's design; the computer's in slice 38, the phones' in slice 40; docs/ui.md, "The talent trees"), round the layout's tree and ring metrics: each ladder's line through its steps in `rail`, layout.treeLink wide, from its first step's centre to its top step's; the quiet marks in `quiet`: a ladder that waits whole drawn as a dashed line of layout.treeLink with a dot on each of its steps (on the phones dashLength on and dashGap off, as the computer's web view draws its own dashed line of that width), a thin row's dot, `dot` round, on each ladder's line, and a shut step's dashed edge, layout.treeHalo wide just inside its tile's well; under each column's top step a diamond, a square of `diamond` turned 45° in that step's quality tone (`quiet` with none), its centre on the line under that step's row; the ring round the player's step, from 12 o'clock clockwise round the tile's rounded square, layout.ringWidth wide, its track in `ringTrack` and its fill in `ringFill`, its star ticks cut across it in `cut`, each tickFraction of the ring's length, stroked a hairline wider than the ring on each side; the glow, a static halo round that ring in the pitch's clearance: a band of layout.treeHalo in `halo` hugging the ring's outer edge under `haloGlow`, a soft glow five times treeHalo wide, pulsing once at a session's first opening down to pulseOpacity at its middle (motion.pulse; none under reduced motion); the selected step's outline and a search match's in `outline`, layout.treeHalo wide in the clearance, in place of the halo (one mark at a time, layout's about), a match's small mark a round `mark` in `outline` at the node's top trailing corner, ringed with layout.treeHalo in `cut`, and every other step at dimOpacity while a search outlines its matches; a selected step's links, straight arrows in `link`, layout.treeLink wide, each ending in an arrowhead arrowHead long and as wide at its base; a step a set opened flashing once over its well in its quality tone up to flashOpacity (motion.nodeFlash); the beads (slice 42) under each ladder's ringed step whose climb has a path and nowhere else, one a stage of it, layout.treeBead wide and layout.treeBeadGap apart in the band of layout.treeBeadRow its row gains: a stage done a bead filled in `beadDone`, one open and not done a ring of beadStroke in `beadOpen`, one waiting for the move before it a dot beadWaitingFraction of a bead wide in `beadWaiting`, so fill and size tell them apart, never colour alone; a bead a set finished fills with motion.ringFill (reduced motion at once).

curve.about: Cubic-bezier control points (x1, y1, x2, y2); `linear` is the straight line, for a motion that cycles evenly.

motion.about: Each animation's duration and curve and its reduced alternative under Reduce Motion (iOS, watchOS) or a zero animator scale (Android): `fade` runs a fade of `reducedMs` instead (on Android under a duration scale of 1, `RealTimeMotion`, since at 0 Compose ends every animation on its first frame), `still` shows the end state at once (docs/ui.md, "Motion"; starting values, tuned on the devices).

press.note: the press darkens and sinks 2 pt (Surface.Press); reduced, at once

glow.note: the glow shows without its fade

settle.note: the settle wait: how long a pump's stage, the buttons a step put in place of others and an ask's answers after a move take no tap, click or key once they show, so the tap or the key that ended what stood there never answers what came in its place; longer than a double tap's gap, short against a tap meant; the game's C.answer_settle_s, the same half second (2026-10-31); a wait, never an animation: its readers take its duration, which Reduce Motion leaves as it is

window.note: a scale from 0.96 with a fade; reduced, a fade

windowOut.note: a window closing: the opening backwards, down to window's scaleFrom as it and its dim fade; reduced, a fade

result.note: the Result's one reveal from its first frame to its last row's shine (an Epic or Legendary row's pulse too), 2.5 s at most: the bars and the words at 0, the XP counting up and the bar filling from 300 ms, the rows from 900 ms at the chip's stagger, closer when many come; a tap lands every part at its end; reduced, the end state at once

busy.note: a busy button's three pips lit in turn, one cycle at an even pace; reduced, a still row

digitPop.note: a scale from 1.25 to 1 within the 1.0-s digit; reduced, the digit swaps in place

pulse.note: the reaching chip's dot fading out and back in, one cycle; reduced, a still dot

muscleLight.note: a muscle the player's first pump in the app trained fades up on Hero from the untrained dark into its quality's tone, once, as the first Result's Continue lands there; reduced, it shows lit at once

treeSelect.note: a talent tree's step selected (a long press, a click or Enter, a cross-tree chip, a card's button to another ladder's step or Show in tree) or, on the computer, previewed (the pointer resting, the keyboard's focus): its links and its outline fade in as quickly as a glow; reduced, at once

ringFill.note: after a set started from the tree, once the pump's cover or dim has gone (the card closed on a phone and a narrow desktop window, the started step selected and in view; the card staying where it pins beside the board), a 150-ms hold, then the ring fills from its old share to its new one, long enough to be seen right after a screen change, while a ring that moves to another step (a climb done, a step down) or falls shows its new share at once; a tap lands it; reduced, the new fill at once

nodeFlash.note: a step the set opened flashes once in its quality's tone over the well after the ring's fill, 200 ms up to 60 % at most and 400 ms down, one cycle; reduced, no flash, the step shown opened

pour.note: a hold's seconds pour on the computer and in the game (slice 65, Rapha, 2026-11-03: 25 % faster than the mockup's version 4): one grain a second held leaves the ring's tip holdMs after Done, the grains' starts spread over min(ms, baseMs + stepMs a second held) and coming closer as they go (each at that span times (i / n)^0.62), each flying pourFly into its second's place on the HoldBar, where it lands with a tick; a tap or a click lands the pour at its end; reduced, no pour: the bar stands filled and the posts passed at once

pourPhone.note: the seconds pour on the phones (slice 65), as motion.pour with a shorter most for the smaller stage

pourFly.note: one grain's flight from the ring's tip into its second's place on the HoldBar on the computer and in the game (slice 65), along a curve that sags 30 px below the straight line at its middle, fading to 30 % as it lands

pourFlyPhone.note: the grain's flight on the phones (slice 65), as motion.pourFly

stepReveal.note: the step-up reveal after a hold's pour (slice 65; StepReveal): the ladder comes in over 340 ms, the light runs along the rail from 560 ms for 440 ms, the lock shakes at 920 ms, and at revealFromMs the next step opens (its lock flies, its tile pops to 1.28 and settles at 1.1, the flash, the shockwave and the sparks, unlock_bright); the move rises at revealFromMs + 160, its caption, name and quality word follow by 520 ms; it folds into its unlock row at ms, or at endMs when the step brings a new colour, whose rays and second burst need the time; a tap lands it; reduced, the end state at once and its jingle

glowMove.note: the tree's one glow crossfades from its old step to its new one while the step flashes, so the whole return (ringFill's hold 150 and fill 400, nodeFlash 600, with room for the cover's own exit) ends within 1.4 s with no sound and no unlock haptic; a tap lands every part at its end; reduced, the glow on its new step at once

sagaReveal.note: the Saga on its first open each game day (the phones' and the desktop's day page) and the best-day moment: the strip's bars grow up from the axis left to right, each staggerMs after the one before, the day's number counts up from 0 over ms and pops at its end (digitPop), the muscles light in turn (muscleLight each, staggerMs apart) and the best day's banner bars slide in (fanfareBars); the reveal feedback (the best day's milestone) once; reduced, the end state at once

bestDayRays.note: the best-day moment's rays (surface.BestDay) turn one full turn in ms, clockwise, for as long as it shows; reduced, they stand still

sagaReel.note: the day reel (slice 45; surface.SagaReel, contract/fixtures/history.json saga rule 18): each move's shot ms long at its film's real tempo, cut hard to the next, then the end endMs on the lead again; every frame draws the Saga's reveal (sagaReveal with its digitPop) as it stands revealFromMs before the frame's time, so the number counts up from 0 and pops at revealFromMs + sagaReveal's ms (1.4 s); these numbers time the file, never the screen, and stand under Reduce Motion too; reduced, the Share window's ReelPreview stands on the reel's last frame until a tap plays it

grow.note: a tapped tile growing into the card or window it opens (slice 46: a tree's node, a ladder page's step tile, a Moves tile, a card's other-move tile; the phones' Window and the desktop's pinned card and card window): Material's container transform, the window's box from the tile's box at the tap, worked out from the grid and never read back, to its own, its content fading in and fit to its width, the dim fading in with it; reduced, the window's fade (window.reducedMs), no box

growBack.note: a window that grew from a tile shrinking back into it as it closes, where that tile is at least half in view (else windowOut); a drag close slides out instead (windowDrag), and a swap or a return never grows or shrinks; reduced, the window's fade

windowDrag.note: a released drag on a phone's window (slice 46; surface.Window's dragClose, dragFlick and dragResistFraction): past dragClose or above dragFlick downward it slides out the rest of its height with its dim, else it settles back to its place, as Material's sheet animates its anchors (a 300-ms tween); none on the desktop; reduced, the window follows the finger all the same (the player's own motion), a release that closes fades it and its dim out over reducedMs and one that settles puts it back at once

feedback.about: Each event's phone haptic (iOS SensoryFeedback; Android HapticFeedbackConstants, with the constant used below the API level that added it), its phone sound (contract/design/sound/sounds.json), its watch haptic (watchOS WKHapticType, Wear OS VibrationEffect), the desktop app's sound and voice line (`desktop`, slice 35: a computer has no haptics, so a moment the phones mark by touch alone takes a sound or the voice there; `voice` names a take of the addon's voice by its VoiceClips.lua id, or a family of them as `<prefix>.*`, the take Speech.lua's rules pick: the move's cadence, the count that is due) and its reduced-motion rule. The phones' sounds follow the game's cues (David, 2026-10-12: the phones play the addon's audio): `mark` ticks a timer's mark the voice does not say (Speech.lua's tick), `lastFive` each of a timed move's last 5 s (Panel.lua's lastFive beeps) and `win` the game's small chime (Panel.lua's win): a hold's stopwatch passing its goal, once a side, and a catch-up's count saved past last time's or as a placement, where `record` marks a record. The watches play no sound and keep the turn-in, tick, go and done haptics, the time up of a catch-up's target (one, so the player stops without looking; 2026-10-04) and the refusal of a pump asked for while felt unwell locks pumps, none decorative (each pauses heart-rate collection). Since slice 53 `shout` is the watches' double tap at an all-out window's 15 and 10 s left, where the phones and the desktop app say the voice's shout (Speech.lua's shout: the callout families shout15 and shout10, picked as the game picks them).

tab.reduced: the glow shows without its fade

tick.reduced: the digit swaps in place, no pop

done.reduced: the check shows without its tick-in

pourTick.reduced: no pour: the bar stands filled at once and only the move's one jingle plays

pourPost.reduced: no pour: the posts stand passed at once, no tick

pourTop.reduced: no pour: the full bar stands without its flash and sparks

record.reduced: the toast shows still, no shine

title.reduced: the toast shows still, no shine

levelUp.reduced: a still banner, no bar sweep

milestone.reduced: a still banner, no bar sweep

reveal.reduced: every row at once, still, with the pump's one strongest event (a level, then a streak milestone, an unlock, a title, a record, a reveal)

unlock.reduced: the row shows still, no shine

unlockUncommon.reduced: the row shows still, no shine

unlockRare.reduced: the row shows still, no shine

unlockEpic.reduced: the row shows still, no shine or pulse

unlockLegendary.reduced: the row shows still, no shine or pulse; the Legendary moment shows the move's still, no glow rising

contrast.about: Every foreground on a background the apps draw, with its minimum ratio (WCAG 2 relative luminance): 4.5 for text, 3 for control edges, graphics and large text; a name is a colour, `quality.<q>` (its tone) or `quality.<q>.ink`, or a path into `surface` (a gradient's stop by its index). Not listed on purpose: line and lineStrong (1.25:1 and 1.6:1), decoration that never alone marks a control (Increase Contrast lifts them, increaseContrast); a disabled control's text3 words on raised (2.9:1 at the mockup's and 4.1:1 here; WCAG exempts an inactive control); the light toggle knob on gold, since the gold fill against the off track carries the state; the reward pill's rewardGlyph on its wash (2.7:1), decoration beside the reward's words; the record chip's uncommon words on its 10 % wash over card (7.7:1, the wash lifting card by under a hundredth of luminance); the quality tones on parchment, where a tile's dark well carries the edge and a word takes the tone's ink twin.
